## Editorial result

The old generic pages previously shared a thin pattern of a lede, three outcomes, two short sections, a command block, and one or two links. PR `#44` adds an explicit deep-content upgrade for each of the 22 legacy generic pages.

Each upgraded generic page now has at least five substantive sections and at least two supporting source/reference links. The content is differentiated by reader decision rather than keyword substitution:

- use cases explain why and when to investigate a class of run;
- integrations document current runtime, binary, TLS, container, and native-telemetry compatibility boundaries;
- Claude/Codex observability landings describe the multi-layer observability stack instead of duplicating the integration pages;
- `/mcp-server-audit/` is a concrete, reproducible audit method using the AgentSight MCP fixture;
- comparison pages use current primary sources and state complementary use cases rather than forcing a winner/loser feature table;
- Agent Flamegraph now explains stack semantics, weighting modes, tagging reproducibility, drill-down, and limitations;
- the older review-artifact Blog now separates observed facts, deterministic summaries, inference, redaction, uncertainty, and reproduction;
- eBPF and file-access landings now explain the actual measurement mechanisms and capture limits rather than generic SEO copy.

The Security page now explicitly covers local-first storage versus sensitivity, privileged observation, targeted recording, export/OTel boundaries, redaction, absence uncertainty, reproducibility, and safe public reporting.

## Primary-source basis

AgentSight-specific behavior is grounded in the current `v1.0.3` source and documentation, including supported-agent/runtime notes, `agentpprof`, OpenTelemetry export, the MCP test fixture, the OpenClaw container experiment, `sslsniff`, and Codex/rustls offset detection.

External technical comparisons use current primary sources from OpenTelemetry, Claude Code, Gemini CLI, the open-source Codex OpenTelemetry implementation, Cloudflare AI Gateway, Langfuse, LangSmith, Model Context Protocol, and Linux kernel uprobe documentation. No customer, benchmark, compatibility, or roadmap claim was invented.

## Quality regression gate

Each upgrade must contain at least five substantive section bodies and at least two supporting references. The existing route, title, slug, and internal-link checks remain active. This turns the new content floor into CI policy rather than a one-time rewrite.
